decks.notes: This deck focuses on using Cascade mechanics to quickly put pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures and spells. By using cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck can cast spells for free while also getting additional value from Cascade triggers. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and efficient aggro strategy, utilizing cards like Bonecrusher Giant and Brazen Borrower to control the board and ensure victory. The inclusion of powerful cards like Endurance and Force of Negation helps the deck maintain its tempo and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on efficiently controlling the board with a mix of counterspells, removal, and card draw while putting pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent. By disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal, while also developing their own board presence, this deck aims to quickly close out games before the opponent can stabilize. The inclusion of Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration helps maintain card advantage and keep the momentum in their favor, while the mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's aggressive game plan.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to control the game early with disruptive spells like Spell Pierce and Counterspell while deploying efficient threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent to apply pressure. The deck also utilizes cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration to keep the hand full and stay ahead of the opponent. Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat provide additional removal and reach to close out games. The land base is optimized for a fast and consistent mana base to support the aggressive game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through counterspells, removal spells, and powerful planeswalkers. Using cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Archmage's Charm, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage through spells like Opt and Snapcaster Mage. The win conditions revolve around powerful threats like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and The Wandering Emperor, backed up by versatile removal spells like Supreme Verdict and Prismatic Ending. Overall, this deck seeks to slow down the game and outvalue the opponent in the long run.

The deck focuses on utilizing Amulet of Vigor to untap lands and generate additional mana to quickly ramp into powerful threats like Primeval Titan. The deck also utilizes lands with powerful abilities like Urza's Saga and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle to generate additional value. The combination of ramp, land recursion, and powerful threats allows the deck to assemble a powerful board state quickly and overwhelm opponents with large creatures and efficient land destruction.

This deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. The combo potential is enhanced by cards like Transmogrify and Wrenn and Six, while also utilizing Prismari Command for flexibility. The deck also includes control elements like Spell Pierce and Lightning Bolt to disrupt opponents. By incorporating cards that generate tokens like Hard Evidence and Dwarven Mine, the deck can quickly ramp up its resources and overwhelm opponents with a mix of creativity and strategic play.

This deck focuses on controlling the board with a combination of powerful Elementals and versatile spells. By utilizing cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six, the deck can disrupt the opponent's strategy while generating incremental card advantage. The Elemental creatures provide a strong offensive and defensive presence, with Omnath, Locus of Creation serving as a versatile finisher. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value through blinking permanents for recurring abilities. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent in a longer game.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by disrupting the opponent's mana base with cards like Molten Rain, Blood Moon, and Pillage. Utopia Sprawl and Arbor Elf are used to ramp up mana quickly, while cards like Trinisphere and Bonecrusher Giant help to control the board. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer provide card advantage and pressure the opponent, while Fury acts as a versatile removal spell. The deck aims to quickly establish a dominant board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through various spells and creatures, while utilizing the companion Yorion, Sky Nomad for additional value. The deck includes a mix of removal, card draw, and versatile creatures to disrupt the opponent's game plan and maintain control of the board. With a combination of powerful control cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Utopia Sprawl, as well as creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Skyclave Apparition, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and secure victory through careful manipulation of the game state.

The main concept of the deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Azusa, Primeval Titan, and Arboreal Grazer in order to play powerful lands like Urza's Saga and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. By utilizing Amulet of Vigor, the deck can take advantage of multiple land drops in a turn, allowing for explosive plays and the ability to search for key cards with cards like Expedition Map and Tolaria West. The deck aims to assemble the powerful Amulet Titan combo and overwhelm the opponent with massive creatures and land-based strategies.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to cheat out big threats like Primeval Titan and Cultivator Colossus while establishing a strong board presence with Amulet of Vigor and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove. It utilizes specific lands like Urza's Saga and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle to generate additional value and win conditions. The deck also includes versatile cards like Expedition Map and Summoner's Pact to ensure consistency and flexibility in executing its game plan. By efficiently utilizing lands and creatures, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory through explosive combos.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Cascade mechanic to quickly and efficiently cast powerful spells for free. By including cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a continuous stream of threats. Additionally, the deck includes control elements like Force of Negation and Archmage's Charm to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also utilizes versatile cards like Brazen Borrower and Dead / Gone to deal with a variety of threats. Overall, the strategy revolves around aggressive plays and capitalizing on the free spell advantage provided by Cascade.

This deck focuses on quickly equipping Colossus Hammer onto creatures like Gingerbrute or Ornithopter to deal massive damage early in the game. Cards like Puresteel Paladin and Sigarda's Aid help to reduce the cost of equipping and protect the equipped creature. The main goal is to assemble the combo pieces efficiently using Urza's Saga to tutor for key cards like Colossus Hammer. The deck aims to win with a powerful and unexpected attack, catching opponents off guard and overwhelming them with a fast and lethal strategy.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying threats and disrupting the opponent's strategy with a mix of counterspells and removal spells. By utilizing efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, along with versatile spells like Lightning Bolt and Archmage's Charm, the deck aims to apply pressure while controlling the board. Mishra's Bauble helps to dig for key cards and smooth out draws, creating a streamlined and aggressive tempo strategy. The land base supports the deck's mana requirements and allows for flexibility in casting spells.
